question: Which hopping concept should the ASTER-01 ground demonstrator carry into preliminary design?
decision_status: PENDING — recommendation only; no decision has been recorded by the decision owner
context: Synthetic demonstration. Alternatives come from the screened trade space (ASTER-TRADE-001). Weights are PROPOSED by the systems-architect and have not been confirmed by the decision owner. Every score is an engineering estimate or first-order analysis (lowg_calc.py outputs/04b-lowg-sizing.json); no score comes from test or measurement.

criteria.name: Peak stored mechanical energy during ground trials
Time to relocate 10 m including settle
